source.title: Armagh Guardian, 20 May 1955, p. 5 ("Not a Single Contest: County and Rural Councillors Unopposed") ("The Rural Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page (clean apart from the noted spellings; not compared line by line with the image); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1955: no contests; nominations received by J. A. Dawson, returning officer. Returned unopposed. John J. Allen: no party label printed in 1955. At other elections he stood as Unionist (South-East Ward, Armagh Urban District, 18 May 1955, printed 'U.': Armagh Guardian, 6 May 1955, p. 1 ("Armagh Council elections: no opposition for Unionists"; "To be returned unopposed"); South-East Ward, Armagh Urban District, 21 May 1958, printed 'all Unionist': Armagh Guardian, 9 May 1958, p. 5 ("Armagh City Council elections: contests in two wards, Unionists unopposed")).
